title: Integrate the legacy DeepSeek laboratory line without regressing current main
dependencies: current-main parent 389b131f and retained source parent a31d004d
strategy: two-parent current-main-wins merge with dependency-safe live ports
primary_claim: The selective integration retains the full DeepSeek-lab history as a merge parent while admitting only the listed architecture/shift ports into the live tree and keeping current main for conflicting runtime, trust, Fourfold and UI paths.

scope.live_tree: exactly the live_ports list and their focused tests
scope.retained_history: the complete source_head as the second merge parent
scope.forbidden_live_replay: every path family named by not_replayed_into_live_tree

not_replayed_into_live_tree: historical loop, config, Forest, index and parser replacements
historical GUI probe and wiki/typegraph stack
reason: Those files were authored against a tree more than two thousand commits behind current main and overlap newer trust, runtime, provider, Fourfold and UI implementations. Replaying them would be a regression rather than an integration. Their exact code remains reachable through the second merge parent.
contracts: The strategy, live_ports, not_replayed_into_live_tree and authority objects are the frozen behavior and authority contract; retained history is not an instruction to replay stale production paths.
acceptance: the source history remains reachable through the exact source_head merge parent
only live_ports and their focused tests are introduced into the live tree
provider, router, loop, config, Forest, parser, environment, MCP, GUI and wiki/typegraph replacements remain historical only
the integration grants no owner approval, gate transition or automatic promotion
evidence: The exact two merge parents, live_ports allowlist and historical-only denylist are retained in this packet for independent tree-diff verification.
migration: No persistent state is migrated; this is a current-main-wins history merge with a bounded live-port allowlist.
rollback: Revert the selective live-port integration commit without rewriting or deleting the retained source history.
